While you have 8 or more wounds, roll 1 additional Skill Die for your Plot Armour when it tries to repel damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.75
system.summary: While you have 8 or more wounds, roll 1 additional Skill Die for your Plot Armour when it tries to repel damage.

automation.note: With 8 or more wounds, when you're hit and Plot Armour rolls, roll 1 extra Skill Die for it: Luck blocks 1 damage; Strange blocks 1 damage and Plot Armour takes 1 wound.
